scripts.build: node scripts/run-workspace-command.mjs workspace-build -- pnpm run build:workspace
scripts.typecheck: node scripts/run-workspace-command.mjs workspace-typecheck -- pnpm run typecheck:workspace
scripts.test: node scripts/run-workspace-command.mjs workspace-test -- pnpm run test:workspace
scripts.test:workspace: pnpm run build:workspace && pnpm -r --workspace-concurrency=1 --if-present test && node --test --test-concurrency=1 verification/cross-host/*.test.mjs && pnpm test:tooling
scripts.test:cross-host: node scripts/run-workspace-command.mjs cross-host-test -- pnpm run test:cross-host:local
scripts.performance:record: pnpm run build:workspace && node scripts/performance/run.mjs record
scripts.performance:compare: pnpm run build:workspace && node scripts/performance/run.mjs compare
scripts.performance:check: pnpm run build:workspace && node scripts/performance/run.mjs check
scripts.record:consumer-bundles: pnpm run build:workspace && node scripts/consumer-bundles/run.mjs record
scripts.check:consumer-bundles: pnpm run build:workspace && node scripts/consumer-bundles/run.mjs check
scripts.record:consumer-install: pnpm run build:workspace && node scripts/consumer-install/run.mjs record
scripts.check:consumer-install: pnpm run build:workspace && node scripts/consumer-install/run.mjs check
scripts.record:source-maps: pnpm run build:workspace && node scripts/source-map-policy.mjs record
scripts.check:source-maps: pnpm run build:workspace && node scripts/source-map-policy.mjs check
scripts.verify:reproducible-build: node scripts/run-workspace-command.mjs reproducible-build-verification -- pnpm run verify:reproducible-build:workspace
scripts.check:component-api: node scripts/run-workspace-command.mjs component-api-check -- pnpm run check:component-api:local
scripts.publish:packages: node scripts/run-workspace-command.mjs package-publication -- pnpm run publish:packages:local
